title: Twelve Monkeys Mangabeys Shorfill 100ml E-Liquid
description: Mangabeys by Twelve Monkeys delivers a sun-soaked blend of lush tropical fruit flavours, combining the juicy sweetness of Guava, ripe Mango, and tangy Pineapple. This vibrant combination creates a bright and refreshing vape, perfectly capturing the balmy character of the tropics with every puff. Designed with a high-VG 70VG/30PG ratio, Mangabeys is perfect for Sub-Ohm vape kits and high-powered DTL (direct-to-lung) devices, ensuring dense vapour production and full-bodied flavour. Supplied in a 100ml shortfill bottle with space for two 10ml nicotine shots, this e-liquid allows vapers to customise their nicotine strength to suit their preference. Twelve Monkeys is an award-winning Canadian e-liquid brand known for its masterful fruit blends, offering expertly crafted flavours with high-quality ingredients for a premium vaping experience.
